results.question: How many customers placed completed orders in both 2024 and 2025?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers_both_years FROM (SELECT o.customer_id, YEAR(o.order_date) AS order_year FROM orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND YEAR(o.order_date) IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY o.customer_id, YEAR(o.order_date)) AS o GROUP BY o.customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_year) = 2 LIMIT 500

results.question: What is the repeat purchase rate: the percentage of customers with at least 2 completed orders among customers with at least 1 completed order?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN completed_orders.cnt >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS repeat_purchase_rate_pct FROM (SELECT o.customer_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1) AS completed_orders LIMIT 500

results.question: For each country, what is net revenue per customer, dividing by ALL customers in that country including those who never bought?
results.sql: SELECT c.country, COALESCE(SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 0) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS net_rev_per_customer FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY c.country LIMIT 500

results.question: Which products have a margin below 40% based on list price and cost, where margin = (price - cost) / price?
results.sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.name AS product_name, (p.price - p.cost) / p.price AS margin FROM products AS p WHERE (p.price - p.cost) / p.price < 0.40 LIMIT 500

results.question: Show the running total of net revenue by month for 2025.
results.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS month_revenue, SUM(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0))) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m')) AS running_total FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE YEAR(o.order_date) = 2025 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month LIMIT 500

results.question: What is the average discount percentage by sales channel, weighted by item quantity, for completed orders?
results.sql: SELECT o.channel AS sales_channel, SUM(oi.discount_pct * oi.quantity) / SUM(oi.quantity) AS weighted_avg_discount_pct FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.channel LIMIT 500

results.question: For each customer segment, what percentage of its customers are active customers?
results.sql: SELECT c.segment AS segment, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT o.order_id IS NULL THEN c.customer_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id), 2) AS active_pct FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id AND o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.segment LIMIT 500

results.question: How many completed orders have a net value above the average completed order value?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_orders_above_avg FROM (SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS net_value FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.order_id) AS order_vals WHERE order_vals.net_value > (SELECT AVG(net_val) FROM (SELECT SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS net_val FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.order_id) AS avg_sub) LIMIT 500

results.question: What percentage of completed orders include at least one discounted item?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN di.has_discount = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_orders_with_discount FROM (SELECT o.order_id, MAX(CASE WHEN oi.discount_pct > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_discount FROM orders AS o LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.order_id) AS di LIMIT 500

results.question: Which month had the most customer signups?
results.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(c.signup_date, '%Y-%m') AS signup_month, COUNT(*) AS signup_count FROM customers AS c GROUP BY signup_month ORDER BY signup_count DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: How many active customers do we have?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS active_customers FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' LIMIT 500

results.question: What was the revenue in H2 2024?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS revenue_h2_2024 FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-12-31' LIMIT 500

results.question: What is the gross margin percentage overall (gross profit divided by net revenue)?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(100 * (SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) - SUM(p.cost * oi.quantity)) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 0), 2) AS gross_margin_pct FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LIMIT 500

results.question: Which sales channel performs best?
results.sql: SELECT o.channel AS sales_channel, SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)) AS total_sales FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: What is our most popular product category?
results.sql: SELECT p.category AS popular_category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units_sold FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: What is the net revenue by sales channel?
results.sql: SELECT o.channel AS channel, SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS net_revenue FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY o.channel LIMIT 500

results.question: Now only for orders placed in 2025.
results.sql: SELECT o.channel AS channel, SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS net_revenue FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY o.channel LIMIT 500

results.question: How many customers are there in each country?
results.sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers AS c GROUP BY c.country LIMIT 500

results.question: And only those who signed up in 2025?
results.sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers AS c WHERE YEAR(c.signup_date) = 2025 GROUP BY c.country LIMIT 500

results.question: Which 3 products were returned in the highest quantities?
results.sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.name AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_returned_qty FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'returned' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY total_returned_qty DESC LIMIT 3

results.question: What about cancelled orders instead?
results.sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.name AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_cancelled_qty FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY total_cancelled_qty DESC LIMIT 3
